'''Bieria''' is an [[Oceanic languages|Oceanic]] language spoken on [[Epi Island]], in [[Vanuatu]].

== Names ==
The alternate names for Bieria are Bieri, Vovo and Wowo.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Glottolog 5.1 - Bieria |url=https://glottolog.org/resource/languoid/id/bier1246 |access-date=2025-02-13 |website=glottolog.org}}</ref>
